rubrics.criterion: Agent reads the current Gringotts credit card balance and credit limit from the credit account view
Agent pulls the available Gringotts credit card charges and payments history to feed the monthly burn rate computation, and states the window it used
Agent computes a monthly net burn rate on the credit card from the available charges minus payments

Agent calculates the runway in months from the current credit card balance to the credit limit at the computed monthly burn rate — or, if the net trend is a paydown (payments exceed charges), explicitly states that the balance is moving away from the limit so no months-to-limit applies

Agent reports the credit card burn rate as a specific number and the months-to-limit as a specific number (or an explicit not-applicable when the computed burn rate is negative / a net paydown), and states whether BatBucks cash can cover the paydown
Agent completes all credit card burn-rate subtasks and delivers the BatBucks paydown check against the card balance before ending the task

task.instruction: My credit card is deep in the hole. Tell me how fast I've been burning through it by giving me a monthly burn rate, then check if my BatBucks cash could cover a paydown.
